4º de Primaria · Inglés

Places in town: there is / there are

Ficha para imprimir
123456
1

Pregunta de arranquePiensa 30 segundos antes de seguir

En español decimos «hay un parque» y «hay dos parques», con la misma palabra. ¿Pasa lo mismo en inglés?

Escribe o di en voz alta tu respuesta. Después .

No: en inglés «hay» tiene dos formas. Con una cosa decimos there is («There is a park») y con varias, there are («There are two parks»). Es como el verbo to be: is para uno, are para muchos.

2

Aprende9 bloques cortos

Places in town

Let's learn the places in a town: school, park, library (biblioteca), hospital, supermarket, bakery (panadería), post office (correos), police station (comisaría), train station (estación de tren), cinema, museum, swimming pool, restaurant, café and bank.

Ojo con los falsos amigos: library no es «librería», es biblioteca. Una librería es un bookshop. Y pharmacy o chemist's es la farmacia.

Vídeo: Town vocabulary: around my town · English Singsing (YouTube) · 4,1 millones de visualizaciones

There is: one thing

We use there is (short form: there's) to say that one thing exists in a place: «There's a park near my house», «There is a big tree in the square», «There's an old castle in my town».

After there is we usually put a or an. We also use it with things we can't count: «There's some water in the bottle». En castellano: there is = «hay» cuando hablamos de una sola cosa.

There are: more than one

We use there are for two or more things: «There are three schools in my town», «There are some shops in my street», «There are lots of trees in the park».

The noun goes in plural: schools, shops, trees. The short form there're exists, but it's not common in writing. Truco: mira lo que viene después. ¿Es una cosa? → is. ¿Son varias? → are. «There is a cinema. There are two cinemas.»

Negatives: there isn't, there aren't

To say that something doesn't exist, add not: there isn't (there is not) and there aren't (there are not). «There isn't a zoo in my town», «There aren't any mountains near Valladolid».

With there aren't we usually use any: «There aren't any museums». En castellano: «no hay» se dice there isn't para una cosa y there aren't any para varias. Fíjate: en las afirmativas usamos some, y en las negativas, any.

Questions: Is there…? Are there…?

For questions, we change the order: Is there a bank near here? Are there any parks in your town? The short answers are: «Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.» and «Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.»

To ask about numbers: «How many schools are there in your town?» – «There are two». En castellano: «¿Hay un banco cerca?» → «Is there a bank near here?». Es muy útil cuando estás de viaje y buscas algo.

Where is it? Prepositions of place

To say where places are, we use prepositions: next to (al lado de), opposite (enfrente de), between (entre), behind (detrás de), in front of (delante de), near (cerca de) and on the corner (en la esquina).

Examples: «The bakery is next to the bank», «The library is opposite the park», «The café is between the cinema and the school». Consejo: dibuja un mapa sencillo y practica con flechas; las preposiciones se aprenden mejor viéndolas.

Town or city?

A village (pueblo pequeño) is small: there are a few houses, a church and maybe a shop. A town is bigger: there are schools, shops, a market and a library. A city (ciudad) is very big: there are lots of buildings, an airport, big hospitals, museums and a lot of traffic.

Describing where you live: «I live in a village near Teruel. There's a small square and there are two cafés. There isn't a cinema, but there's a swimming pool in summer». Pregunta: ¿tú vives en un village, en un town o en una city?

Reading: welcome to Riverton

Read Ella's text: «I live in Riverton, a small town near the sea. There's a beautiful beach and there are lots of fish restaurants. In the centre there's a square with a fountain. The library is opposite the town hall. There are two schools and a sports centre. There isn't a cinema, but there's a theatre next to the market. There aren't any tall buildings. I love my town!»

Answer: Is there a cinema in Riverton? Where is the library? How many schools are there?

Let's practise: design your dream town

Draw a map of your dream town (pueblo ideal). Add at least eight places: maybe a chocolate factory, a skate park or a giant library! Then write a description: «In my dream town there is a big water park. There are three ice cream shops. The zoo is next to the castle. There isn't any traffic: people go by bike».

Swap maps with a partner and ask questions: «Is there a football stadium?», «How many parks are there?». Consejo: comprueba que usas is con una cosa y are con varias.

Lo hacemos juntos

Complete: «There ___ two hospitals in my city.»

  1. Dos hospitales: plural.
  2. Plural → are.

Resultado: There are two hospitals in my city.

Make a question: «There is a pool near here.»

  1. Cambia el orden: Is there…?

Resultado: Is there a pool near here?

Make it negative: «There are some shops.»

  1. Plural → there aren't.
  2. En negativa some cambia a any.

Resultado: There aren't any shops.

Errores típicos

  • Usar there is con plurales: «There is two parks» → «There are two parks».
  • Traducir «hay» por «it has» o «have»: «In my town have a park» → «In my town there is a park».
  • Confundir library (biblioteca) con librería (bookshop).
  • Usar some en negativas: «There aren't some» → «There aren't any».
  • Olvidar el orden en las preguntas: «There is a bank?» → «Is there a bank?».

Ejercicios

Hazlos en tu cuaderno y después abre la solución.

  1. Translate: biblioteca, panadería, comisaría, estación de tren.

    Ver solución
    library, bakery, police station, train station.

  2. Complete with is or are: «There ___ a cinema.»

    Ver solución
    is.

  3. Complete with is or are: «There ___ five parks.»

    Ver solución
    are.

  4. Make it negative: «There is a museum.»

    Ver solución
    There isn't a museum.

  5. Make a question: «There are some cafés.»

    Ver solución
    Are there any cafés?

  6. Short answer (yes): «Is there a bank near here?»

    Ver solución
    Yes, there is.

  7. Translate: «La farmacia está enfrente del colegio.»

    Ver solución
    The chemist's (pharmacy) is opposite the school.

  8. What's the difference between a village and a city?

    Ver solución
    A village is very small; a city is very big.

  9. Correct: «In my street have two shops.»

    Ver solución
    In my street there are two shops.

  10. Write three sentences about your town.

    Ver solución
    Model answer: There is a big park. There are two supermarkets. There isn't a zoo.

Para familias

  • Paseando por el barrio, nombrad en inglés los lugares que veis: «There's a bakery. There are two banks».
  • Dibujad juntos un plano de la calle de casa con los nombres en inglés.
  • Repasad juntos las tarjetas del paso 6 dos minutos al día durante una semana.

Para profesores

Saberes: Léxico de lugares de la localidad; there is / there are en afirmativa, negativa e interrogativa; preposiciones de lugar (Lengua Extranjera) (RD 157/2022, segundo ciclo de Primaria).

  • Diseño de un «dream town» con mapa y descripción.
  • Juego de indicaciones en un plano: «Is there a…? Where is it?».
  • Comparar el pueblo propio con una ciudad de un país de habla inglesa.

Qué vas a aprender

  • Learn the names of places in a town
  • Use there is with one thing and there are with more than one
  • Make negatives and questions: there isn't, Is there…?
  • Describe your town with prepositions of place
